lines.text: Bro, if Chloe doesn't get back with the notes in two minutes, we're failing this test.
Attention, Oakridge High. Every exit is sealed. Cell towers are jammed. Stay in your classrooms, keep your hands visible, and nobody gets hurt.
Get down! Stay away from the windows!
Those aren't cops... who are they?
Library's locked. Bring the breach kit.
They're gonna blow the front door. The back stairwell, we can slip out right now!
Guys?! Please, open it! I'm locked out in the stairwell. I hear them coming up!
Wait! Look at the security monitor!
He's right behind her... she doesn't even see him.
Please! Don't leave me out here! Open the door!
If you open that door, he shoots all of us. If we don't... she's dead.
Save Chloe and walk into an ambush... or stay quiet and let them breach the front?
